title: When Ecological Representations Stop Travelling
editorial_principle: Each chapter is organized around one source-owned forbidden inference. The order is editorial, not a privileged theorem order.
claim_ceiling: The final chapter order does not transfer theorem, code, data, or evidence ownership to theouni.
The worldline atlas remains a non-ordered theory map; this file fixes only the dissertation traversal.
MRM and RACH remain independent companion programmes but are not primary dissertation chapters in this final ten-chapter spine.
TU-2, TU-3, and TU-4 remain embedded firewalls; TU-1 is the synthesis module.
Chapter 2 may precede Chapter 4 editorially because warning outcomes import their source-frozen loss/event definitions rather than deriving them from the later chapter.

chapters.title: 再利用問題
chapters.headline_result: The dissertation asks when a representation that was adequate for one scientific responsibility may be reused after the responsibility changes.
chapters.primary_forbidden_inference: 一度うまくいった表現 ⇒ 以後どの責任にも再利用できる表現
chapters.transition: 再利用を阻む最初の限界は、観測そのものが原理的に届かない範囲にあるのか？

chapters.title: 観測が原理的に届かない範囲
chapters.english_title: Where Observation Cannot Reach in Principle
chapters.headline_result: Mechanistic proximity and identification strength are distinct: endpoint-only observation leaves k-1 product-preserving degrees of freedom, and r independent channel anchors leave k-1-r.
chapters.primary_forbidden_inference: 観測を豊かにした ⇒ 潜在機構に近づいた
chapters.transition: 観測できた信号が機構を同定しないとしても、その信号は将来の損失を警告できるのか？

chapters.title: 先行することは、警告することではない
chapters.headline_result: Frozen genetic erosion thresholds can precede every audited event yet fire in every audited non-event, so temporal precedence alone does not establish predictive warning validity.
chapters.primary_forbidden_inference: 損失に先行した ⇒ 損失を予告する
chapters.transition: 先行性だけでは警告にならないなら、限られた観測能力のもとで次に何を測るべきか？

chapters.title: 境界の内側で、次に何を測るか
chapters.english_title: What to Measure Next Inside the Boundary
chapters.headline_result: Among verified candidate observations, information-guided sequential design ranks measurements by current mechanism information and recomputes value after each realised outcome rather than treating every measurable variable as equally useful.
chapters.primary_forbidden_inference: 測れるものは測る価値がある ⇒ 測る順序に良し悪しはない
chapters.transition: 次に測る量を選べても、そもそも一つの系を一つの状態で代表してよいのか？

chapters.title: 一つの系に、状態は一つではない
chapters.english_title: One System Does Not Have One State
chapters.headline_result: Potential viability, realised occupancy, demographic state, genetic diversity, and allele persistence can respond differently to the same fragmentation contrast, while coarse marginals can hide transition-relevant cross-layer alignment.
chapters.primary_forbidden_inference: 生態遺伝的に要約した ⇒ 五つの側面を代表した
chapters.transition: 必要な状態が責任ごとに違うなら、許される未来を広げたとき必要な記憶はどう変わるのか？

chapters.title: 未来を開くと、記憶が要る
chapters.headline_result: Interfaces that remain small under fixed closed future grammars can require exponentially more states, or m additional bits, when the legal future grammar is opened.
chapters.primary_forbidden_inference: 物理的境界が狭い ⇒ 必要な因果記憶も小さい
chapters.transition: 未来を開くことで記憶負担が増えるなら、介入能力そのものの小さな増加は知識負担も小さく保てるのか？

chapters.title: 能力は知識を追い越す
chapters.headline_result: For every m >= 1, one newly admitted controllable action can add exactly one viable world while forcing a retained present slice to refine from one state to 2^m states, producing exactly m bits of monitoring debt under unchanged evidence.
chapters.primary_forbidden_inference: 介入の規模が小さい ⇒ 表現と監視の負担も小さい
chapters.transition: 必要な表現を更新できても、その表現上の法則は構造置換後にもそのまま運べるのか？

chapters.title: 法則は構造置換を越えない
chapters.english_title: Laws Do Not Automatically Survive Structural Replacement
chapters.headline_result: An inherited source macro-law transports only under explicit source-target coherence; otherwise the target requires source-relative repair and, when routes disagree, explicit history context.
chapters.primary_forbidden_inference: ある構造で成り立った法則 ⇒ 置換後の構造でも成り立つ法則
chapters.transition: 構造を越えた法則の再利用に条件が要るなら、同じ観測手法を繰り返すことは証拠の強さを自動的に増やすのか？

chapters.title: 反復は、多様性の代わりにならない
chapters.english_title: Repetition Does Not Substitute for Diversity
chapters.headline_result: Repeated observations sharing one failure domain cannot generally substitute for independent failure opportunities; target reporting remains set-valued unless the declared observation and risk contract supports sharper resolution.
chapters.primary_forbidden_inference: 同じ手法を繰り返した ⇒ 証拠が強くなった
chapters.transition: ここまでの失敗を、より詳細・より多測定・より長い記憶・より大きな介入という一方向の妥当性序列に並べられるのか？

chapters.title: 総合 — 妥当性に特権的な方向はない
chapters.english_title: Synthesis — Adequacy Has No Privileged Direction
chapters.headline_result: TU-1 shows that revisability after compression is a factorization property, while the dissertation as a whole shows that richer observation, larger state, longer memory, stronger intervention, and repeated evidence are not one monotone axis of scientific adequacy.
chapters.primary_forbidden_inference: より詳細にする／より多く測る／より長く記憶する／より多く介入する ⇒ より妥当になる
chapters.transition: 終章：妥当性は情報量の一方向の序列ではなく、責任ごとの因子化・同定・再利用条件として評価する。

MRM.role: mechanism-response companion; may support Chapters 3-4 but owns no primary chapter here

RACH.role: causal-programme companion and historical substrate for MROD; comparison material for Chapter 3

source_preconditions.condition: Warning event/non-event labels and loss endpoints are imported from the frozen EGWE/parent source contracts; Chapter 2 does not infer them from Chapter 4.
